currentKnownProblems.summary: Tool-host child process launch can return EPERM while direct commands pass.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Release artifact git-status preflight and full dev Docker workspace copy can exceed useful latency on the mounted WSL workspace.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Use the clean publish ext4 worktree for release artifacts and treat the direct /workspace Docker build path as the fallback when sync-copy stalls.
